lead_raw_text:
The structure of Sr4Ho2 (Sr2Ho) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with a unit cell containing six atoms across three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows both Ho and Sr centers with 12 geometric neighbors in a close-packed-like local arrangement, with Ho coordinated by 8 Sr and 4 Ho, and Sr environments including 8 Ho and 4 Sr plus a 12 Sr-only case. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all six sites. Validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between 12-vertex Sr polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Ho- and Sr-centered polyhedra.
